name: Data Transformation & dbt (Data Build Tool)
description: Modular SQL transformations, dbt (Data Build Tool), Jinja templating, incremental materializations, automated testing, dbt snapshots, data lineage, and semantic layers.

subskills.name: dbt Project Structure, ref() & source() Functions
subskills.description: dbt project layout (models, staging, marts, intermediate), source freshness tests, and building dynamic DAGs with ref() and source() macros.

subskills.name: Jinja Templating, Custom Macros & dbt Packages
subskills.description: Jinja control structures (for loops, if conditions), creating reusable SQL macros, using dbt-utils, dbt-expectations packages.

subskills.name: dbt Materializations & Incremental Strategies
subskills.description: View, Table, Ephemeral, and Incremental materializations, is_incremental() macro, merge vs delete+insert vs append incremental strategies, and unique_key design.

subskills.name: dbt Testing (Generic, Singular & Custom Tests)
subskills.description: Built-in generic tests (unique, not_null, accepted_values, relationships), writing singular SQL tests, store_failures, and test severity levels.

subskills.name: dbt Snapshots & Automated SCD Type 2
subskills.description: Automating Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 tables with dbt snapshot, timestamp vs check strategies, target_schema, and dbt_valid_from/to.

subskills.name: dbt Documentation, Column Descriptions & Lineage Graph
subskills.description: Documenting models with schema.yml doc blocks, generating dbt docs, inspecting interactive lineage DAGs, and model selection syntax.

subskills.name: SQLMesh & Next-Gen Transformation Engines
subskills.description: Virtual data environments, column-level lineage, SQLMesh plan & apply, automated plan evaluations, and comparison with dbt-core.

subskills.name: Modular ELT Pipeline Design & Layering
subskills.description: Decoupled transformation design: Ingestion -> Raw Staging -> Base Layer -> Core Business Entities -> Aggregated Data Marts.

subskills.name: dbt Semantic Layer & MetricFlow Integration
subskills.description: Defining semantic models, dimensions, entities, measures, cumulative metrics, derived metrics in MetricFlow, and downstream querying.

cv.signal: Led migration of legacy SQL stored procedures to modular dbt Core pipelines with automated testing

assessment.signal: Passes dbt Transformation & Modular Data Modeling Assessment

junior.description: Structures dbt projects, writes clean ref/source models, implements standard tests (unique, not_null), and generates documentation.

mid.description: Develops complex Jinja macros, builds high-performance incremental models, automates SCD Type 2 snapshots, and designs decoupled marts.

senior.description: Evaluates and implements next-gen virtual data engines (SQLMesh), architects enterprise semantic metric layers, and establishes company-wide transformation standards.
